name: Wordkeep
description: Write Markdown, preview a note, and organize a notebook with folders and checklists.
try: Create a note and switch to the Markdown preview.
alt: Wordkeep notebook on a tablet and Markdown editor on a phone

name: Calcula
description: Flick keys for scientific functions, plot equations, convert units, and reuse answers from your history.
try: Flick up on 7 for sine, or open the unit converter.
alt: Calcula showing a graph, unit conversion, scientific keys, and themes

name: WiFi Weakspot
description: Compare channels and explore a room-by-room signal map using simulated Wi-Fi readings.
try: Switch between the 2.4, 5, and 6 GHz channel views.
alt: WiFi Weakspot channel graphs across 2.4, 5, and 6 GHz

name: SDK Monitor
description: Browse sample Android apps by target SDK and see version changes in the update log.
try: Open an app to see its target SDK and version history.
alt: SDK Monitor analytics, app list, and version details

name: QuietGuard
description: Explore per-app Wi-Fi and mobile data rules in a simulated Android firewall.
try: Toggle Wi-Fi access for a sample app and look through its rules.

name: Keepout
type: Android DNS and firewall · Sample data
description: Explore encrypted DNS, app firewall rules, and traffic statistics using sample connections.
try: Open Activity, then Insights, to see which apps and domains generated sample traffic.
alt: Keepout showing traffic statistics, protection status, and settings

name: Chroma Folio
description: Turn and slice a 3D colour solid, spin colour reels, and build palettes you can export.
try: Open Solid and drag the lightness reel to move the cut.
alt: Chroma Folio showing the OKLCH solid and its lightness and chroma reels

name: Color Blindness Simulator
description: Compare Material 3 color schemes across eight color vision simulations and inspect WCAG contrast ratios.
alt: Color Blindness Simulator comparing Material 3 colors across vision modes
